messages:
Ingrid: Quick check — HelionBank SIG Q4.2 (encryption at rest) landed in my inbox. They want KMS architecture diagram, rotation policy, and a short BYOK statement. Can someone assemble evidence? Deadline EOD Wed. @Tony @Sam
Tony: I have the KMS diagram sketched. Need to confirm we can share the version with ARNs redacted. Link to internal draft: https://confluence.internal/redwood/security/kms-arch (internal)
Sam: I can redact ARNs and account IDs. I'll export the diagram as PDF and drop it in the sales folder. Also will include a short blurb about key policies.
Priya: FYI for the encryption snippet, copy below is what we show customers in POCs. Feel free to reuse: 
```
# S3 server-side encryption example
resource "aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration" "example" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.example.id
  rule {
    apply_server_side_encryption_by_default {
      sse_algorithm     = "aws:kms"
      kms_master_key_id = "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/EXAMPLE"
    }
  }
}
```
Priya: I'll redact the example ARN in the final evidence pack.
Ingrid: Good. Helion specifically asked: do we offer customer-managed keys (BYOK) and what controls around rotation/compromise testing? Need a one-paragraph statement for the SIG.
Tony: Short draft for BYOK: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS. Customers can supply keys (BYOK) or use Redwood-managed keys; keys are controlled by IAM policies with least privilege, rotated according to customer policy, and subject to access logging via CloudTrail and KMS key usage metrics." Use that and I can expand with refs to SOC2+KMS page.
Sam: I uploaded rotation-policy.pdf and kms-redacted-diagram.pdf to our sales share: s3://redwood-sales/helionbank/sig/1718001234/rotation-policy.pdf and s3://redwood-sales/helionbank/sig/1718001234/kms-redacted-diagram.pdf :thumbsup:
SigBot: Heads-up — redaction checklist missing: remove internal account IDs, IPs, and support ticket references. Use /sigbot redact-checklist to confirm.
Priya: On it. I'll run the checklist and create a sanitized logs sample (no IPs, timestamps fuzzed). Expected upload in 2 hours.
Ingrid: Perfect. After Priya uploads, I'll assemble the question-by-question pack and ping HelionBank. If anything else pops up (BYOK attestation or HSM usage), I'll loop legal.
Tony: One more note for the SIG Q table: rotation cadence = 90 days for customer-managed keys, annual compromise simulation/test documented in rotation-policy.pdf.
Sam: I also added a short cover note for the SIG: "Attachments include KMS architecture (redacted), key rotation policy, and sanitized logs for verification." Dropped at s3 link above.
Ingrid: Great work — please add any version numbers or dates to the files so sales has an audit trail. I'll mark this as sent once I get the final sanitized sample.
Priya: Uploaded sanitized-logs-sample.json (IPs redacted) to the same folder.
Sam: Verified files and checksum, everything looks good. Marking thread: resolved :white_check_mark:
Ingrid: Sending to Helion now and cc'ing legal for BYOK attestation. Thanks team!
